reasoning_content:
Good. Flutter 3.35.7 stable with Dart 3.9.2. Download. Let me start the download in background to avoid timeouts. Actually the tarball is ~1GB. Let me use curl with nohup and monitor.

Let me download.

action.command:
mkdir -p /opt/flutter-sdk && cd /opt && nohup curl -sSL -o /tmp/flutter.tar.xz https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.35.7-stable.tar.xz > /tmp/flutter_dl.log 2>&1 &
echo "started pid $!"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "mkdir -p /opt/flutter-sdk && cd /opt && nohup curl -sSL -o /tmp/flutter.tar.xz https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.35.7-stable.tar.xz > /tmp/flutter_dl.log 2>&1 &\necho \"started pid $!\"", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Download Flutter 3.35.7 tarball in background"}
